name: my-marketplace
description: Local marketplace — personal overlay on the AIDD framework

plugins.name: overcode
plugins.description: Extends AIDD with project-agnostic workflows: research; memory maintenance; repository-backed Markdown freshness with AIDD-routed code checks (taste); AIDD-routed document/code foresight plus dependency abandonment and migration horizon (foresee); behavioural testing; test governance; performance, data, ActivityPub, and SEO/GEO audits; project health and repository-backed Markdown backlog synchronization via status; plain-language explanations; documentation; and planning utilities. Stack knowledge remains pivot-driven through sc-* plugins, and AIDD delegation fails explicitly when a required capability is unavailable. Alias chains: rechallenge, endtask, bump-plugin, previously, smarten, skillconf, weeklyemail, gitit, mirror, codex-vision.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Builds, critiques, freezes, enforces, diffuses, and scaffolds grounded measurable design systems, including contract-aware LLM guidance and rendered cascade-ownership proof.

plugins.name: sc-php
plugins.description: PHP and WordPress skills with native FSE patterns, shared front/editor design assets, core-block bindings, guarded WP-CLI, builder coverage, and rendered cascade-ownership proof.

plugins.name: sc-js
plugins.description: JS knowledge provider: detects runtime (web/desktop), framework (Nuxt/Vue/SvelteKit/Alpine/Vite/Astro), ORMs and capabilities, then emits a pivot manifeste. /sc-js:audit delegates code review to aidd-dev:reviewer. improve, legacy (Vue 2→3, ESM, TS), teach (composables, reactivity, async). Perf pivots (SvelteKit), store pivots (Svelte stores), Biome pivot, data pivots for web-optimize and data-optimize. design-bridge: réceptacle du pivot design (enforce → règle ESLint/Biome + pre-commit ; diffuse → composant Vue 3 SFC ou React) ; possède le workflow de plateforme SPA (design:detail). wp-blocks: round-trip de validité des blocs Gutenberg (Playwright, éditeur) pour markup FSE généré hors éditeur.

plugins.name: sc-css
plugins.description: CSS ecosystem skills for auditing and modernising styles; design-bridge now supports mixed platform stacks, disjoint outputs, platform bindings, and static inputs for rendered ownership proof.

plugins.name: sc-tiers
plugins.description: Third-party SaaS consumption guidance installed through host-native project instructions: Firebase Firestore limits, security, quotas, Auth listener cleanup, Hosting headers; Klaviyo API patterns; GTM Consent Mode v2 and Meta Pixel consent; Microsoft Clarity; PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse.

plugins.name: sc-python
plugins.description: Python-specific skills and workflows: two-tier sniff (pivot model), audit (aidd-dev:reviewer), improve, legacy, log-analysis, teach (Django/FastAPI).

plugins.name: sc-rust
plugins.description: Rust-specific skills and workflows: two-tier sniff (pivot model), audit (aidd-dev:reviewer), improve, legacy, log-analysis, teach (Axum/Actix + SQLx/Diesel).

plugins.name: obs
plugins.description: Personal Obsidian notes management, driven by deterministic Python scripts (no model call): the Documents/ organiser tree (cache-based index, check, fix, sort, destinations); filler (survey, sort, index, merge, clean); project (create, invoice, export-rag); mail (rules-based triage of exported mail).

plugins.name: pdf
plugins.description: PDF source ingestion — multi-session extraction of large PDFs into raw Markdown sources under a domain's working directories (extract-pdf).
